Об игреA classic ghost-hunting game packed with puzzles, sudden scares, and fun co-op chases, that becomes one of the most popular Multiplayer horror games.Get full game Horror Simulator VR to unlock more maps & content and have even more fun and thrills!

 👻Play with squad, chase&catch the demon (Easy Peasy!!)• Find the Room: Use your light to spot unusual objects, listen to whispers… is the demon room nearby?

• Use Items&Props: Throw Holy Water to find demon shadows! Hold a Cross to track footsteps! Lots of tools to play!

• Find the demon's name: Solve puzzles of demon’s name. Find the right items and put them on the platform. Hurry up!

• RUN OR HIDE: Hide in closets, scare demons away with the Bible. More Power-up props to fight demons, so much FUN!

☠️Why So Fun?• Interactions: Push the doors, answer phone calls, play the piano... Real scenes, explore freely!

• Voice Chat: Chat with teammates while running. After being killed, become a ghost to give your friends clues!

• Coin Frenzy: Earn coins by completing missions to buy Freddie bear masks, angel avatars, and dress up as the coolest!

☠️FREE Version? Still AWESOME!• Big Mansion map + Classic Mode - Team up with friends for all-night multiplayer sessions!

• Join Discord to unlock Crazy Mode - Join Discord to unlock Crazy Mode - Fight 10 amazing demon powers!

☠️If You're Addicted to...The heart-pounding chase from Animal Company, Noclip VR, Yeeps - our hunting system will make you go crazy! Demons can climb, break doors, and even pretend to be your friend.
